title: [review] message.rs:604: TransitInfo E-flag not validat
description: from_bytes assumes E=1 (parent address present) and reads 16 bytes from data[4..20], but does not verify bit 7 of data[0] is actually set. Per RFC 6550 section 6.7.8, if E=0 the parent address is absent. A malformed option with length=20 but E=0 would cause bytes that RFC says should not exist to be parsed as parent_address. SignedDaoEnvelope mitigates by enforcing length==20, but the raw API trusts callers to provide E=1 data.
